overview: DUET is a global-to-local algorithm that optimizes LLM training data mixtures for unseen evaluation tasks by interleaving Bayesian optimization on mixing ratios with data selection methods like Influence Functions to exploit noisy task feedback.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Parses and manages global settings including dataset paths, model identifiers, Bayesian optimization hyperparameters, LoRA configurations, and sampling size constraints.

modules.name: Multi-Domain Data Preprocessing
modules.description: Loads and tokenizes data from multiple domains, segregates validation splits required for influence computation, and structures domain-specific data pools for sampling.

modules.name: Influence Function Computation
modules.description: Trains domain-specific surrogate models and computes the Influence Function scores for each training data point using Hessian-vector products, storing the pre-computed scores for efficient retrieval.

modules.name: Data Selection and Weighted Sampling
modules.description: Implements data selection estimators including IF-weighted sampling, uniform random sampling, and alternative methods like LESS or Remove Harmful, constrained by a given mixing ratio to retrieve data subsets.

modules.name: Gaussian Process Surrogate Model
modules.description: Defines the Gaussian Process prior with a Squared Exponential kernel, computes posterior mean and variance based on historical observations, and optimizes kernel hyperparameters via maximum likelihood estimation.

modules.name: Constrained Bayesian Optimization
modules.description: Implements the Lower Confidence Bound (LCB) acquisition function and enforces simplex constraints on the mixing ratio to propose the next global mixing ratio for evaluation.

modules.name: DUET Core Algorithm Orchestration
modules.description: Executes the global-to-local optimization loop by querying the Bayesian Optimization module for a mixing ratio, invoking the Data Selection module to form a data mixture, and updating the surrogate model with task feedback.

modules.name: LLM Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
modules.description: Manages the LoRA-based fine-tuning workflow of the target LLM using the selected data mixtures, handling forward/backward passes, optimizer steps, and gradient accumulation.

modules.name: Noisy Feedback Evaluation Interface
modules.description: Interfaces with language model evaluation harnesses to measure performance on unseen tasks, parsing noisy feedback metrics such as task accuracy or loss to be returned to the optimization loop.

modules.name: Baseline Methods Implementation
modules.description: Implements comparison baselines including DoReMi, uniform mixing, LESS, Aioli, and multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization to evaluate against the proposed DUET algorithm.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Framework
modules.description: Configures and runs controlled experiments to analyze the impact of varying sampling sizes, different data selection methods, and the isolated effects of Bayesian Optimization versus data selection.

modules.name: Out-of-Domain Task Configuration
modules.description: Sets up experimental scenarios where the evaluation task domains are intentionally excluded from the training data pools to validate the algorithm's performance on unseen domains.

modules.name: Experiment Tracking and Logging
modules.description: Records the state of Bayesian Optimization iterations, including proposed mixing ratios, observed noisy feedback, Gaussian Process posteriors, and selected data subsets, integrated with monitoring tools.

modules.name: Result Aggregation and Reporting
modules.description: Aggregates results from multiple runs and iterations, computes statistical variances, generates convergence plots, and outputs tables summarizing performance across different tasks and ablation settings.
